rules: DAppSCAN: every distinct file of the authors' per-category list (dasp_categories/DASP_smart_contract_metadata.json), cleaned source + cleaned line labels for the category's SWC ids; left out only when a stage cannot read it (HCG builder, DFG front end, EdgeSem guard mapping) or without a line
SolidiFI: all 50 contracts of the category's SolidiFI folder (Table 2 buggy count = distinct DAppSCAN files + 50 in every category)
DAppSCAN-clean: as many as DAppSCAN buggy files, seeded order from the release's files not listed for the category and without a line labelled with its SWC ids
SmartBugs-Wild-clean: as many as SolidiFI files, seeded order from the 2,742 SmartBugs Wild clean contracts (ge-sc/data/smartbugs-wild-clean-contracts)
clean draws: per category independently; files a stage cannot read and preprocessed-text duplicates of a taken file skipped
project: the DAppSCAN report folder of a file (DAppSCAN-source/contracts/<project>/...)
